title: Item 10 — V1 Production Gate under Mission V1.5
description: Execute Mission V1.5 Stage B B2-B6. Establish the Item 10 Task Contract before implementation, prove deterministic HIGH risk, verify all 20 B4 minimum coverage domains using repository-backed deterministic evidence, preserve the B5 quantitative calibration deferral, and reach B6 only through protected merge plus exact-SHA post-merge canonical and Phase A verification.

why_high: Item 10 is the V1 Production Gate and its result controls whether the multi-agent system may advance into V1 Operational Acceptance.
A false PASS could incorrectly certify trust, security, branch protection, evidence provenance, authority separation, Human Gate or fail-closed behavior.
The task adds deterministic governance verification under scripts/multi-agent/** and test/multi-agent/**, which are enforcement-sensitive governance surfaces.
why_not_lower: Documentation-only classification is insufficient because executable production-gate verification is being added.
The production-gate verifier evaluates controls that govern protected merge eligibility and release trust.

dependencies.name: Mission V1.5 Item 10 canonical specification discovery

acceptance_criteria.description: B2 Task Contract exists as the first Item 10 branch commit before executable Item 10 implementation changes.
B3 deterministic classification resolves effective risk HIGH and Human Gate REQUIRED; no manager or reviewer downgrade is accepted.
Architecture coverage is backed by canonical architecture checks and the Item 10 verifier rejects missing architecture evidence.

Workflow lifecycle and Full State Machine are verified exhaustively across every canonical state pair, including all legal transitions, illegal transitions, rejection routes, Human Gate rules, approval invalidation and terminal immutability.

Scope and Lock coverage proves declared write-scope enforcement, forbidden precedence, history validation, overlap conflicts, read-only reviewer roles, exact task/owner/scope binding, and terminal-only release.
Risk coverage proves deterministic maximum-risk behavior, sensitive floors, anti-downgrade enforcement, HIGH verification gates and Human Gate requirement.
Artifact binding coverage proves exact-byte hashing, operation/path binding and invalidation of artifact-bound Review/Security/Human/Lock evidence after mutation.
Evidence provenance rejects stale evidence and unauthorized transport/commenter evidence and requires exact task/artifact binding.

Authority separation proves Reviewer/QA cannot acquire writer locks, Reviewer cannot remove deterministic checks, trusted Project Owner is the only HIGH Human approver, and self-referential gate bypass is not accepted.
CI coverage proves Canonical CI and Phase A are required and NOT_EXECUTED/FAIL never satisfy verification.
Security and Human Gate coverage proves HIGH requires Security PASS and exact-artifact Owner approval before merge eligibility.
Merge Policy coverage proves merge eligibility requires complete upstream evidence and protected workflow transport; direct/manual main merge remains prohibited.

Branch Protection, bypass actors and trusted integration identity are verified against live ruleset 23278861 with strict required checks verify/phase-a/merge-policy, zero bypass actors and GitHub Actions integration 15368.
Token governance is VERIFIED while quantitative calibration remains DEFERRED_TO_V1_1; synthetic, invented or estimated calibration telemetry is rejected.
Docs automation uses the canonical task catalog generator semantics; generated catalog is exact and stale bytes fail closed.
Post-Merge coverage proves exact merge SHA checkout, credential-free read-only verification, canonical pnpm verify plus Phase A, TOCTOU resistance and fail-visible no-auto-rollback behavior.

Fail-Closed behavior is demonstrated for undefined state transitions, scope violations, lock conflicts, risk downgrade, stale/unauthorized evidence, wrong integration identity, protection drift, missing gates and post-merge failure visibility.
All 20 Mission V1.5 B4 minimum coverage domains are represented in a deterministic evidence matrix with no PENDING/NOT_EXECUTED/UNVERIFIED domain at Item 10 exit.
Exact-head Canonical CI and Phase A PASS, artifact-bound REVIEW/SECURITY/ACTIVE LOCK, then HUMAN_PENDING and exact-artifact Owner approval are required before Merge Policy can become merge-eligible.
B6 may declare ITEM_10=CANONICAL_COMPLETE only after protected merge and exact-SHA post-merge canonical + Phase A verification PASS on the resulting merge SHA.

external_gate_evidence.rule: HIGH Item 10 Production Gate. REVIEW, SECURITY, ACTIVE LOCK and exact-artifact PROJECT_OWNER HUMAN approval are mandatory. Any artifact mutation invalidates all artifact-bound evidence.
